retrieve_scenario_a: retrieve the debate scenario A text and topic constants from the debate module
retrieve_scenario_b: retrieve the debate scenario B text and topic constants from the debate module
wrap_debate_message: wrap a list of debate message strings into 70-character lines using text.wrap
strip_debate_message: strip a debate message block from text using block_msg, block_opt, and terminal_str delimiters
retrieve_alpha_block: retrieve the first contiguous alphabetic substring from a debate message string
